outer_protocol: 16 positive-negative trial pairs; 30 train windows and 10 validation windows
inner_protocol: 3x3 trial pairs within six outer-train trials; 20 train windows and 10 validation windows per fold
aggregation: average five window probabilities within each physical trial, then average four pair predictions
selection: within each candidate/direction, inner OOF trial-aggregated F1-max threshold; ties choose threshold closest to 0.5; candidate/direction selection by AUC then F1 then candidate order
